records.completion_scope: Completed representative-system research. Retained original TPC overview, printed imprint/notes and full native-resolution selected-corridor crop were read; private orientation aids located each of the 11 parts and separate endpoints. Retained authorial chapter prose supplies only independent delta-network context. No new external source acquisition was needed.

records.region: Northern Greenland: southern Mylius-Erichsen Land ice/bedrock margins and the glacier approach to the southwestern head of Independence Fjord.
records.candidate_name_role: No supported representative natural-river identity for the selected glacial corridor and fjord-head composite.
records.naming_scope_hold_reason: Complete geographic corridor correspondence does not establish a representative natural-river hydronym. The ice/bedrock-margin, glacier and fjord sequence is not demonstrated to be one named natural river.
records.completion_scope: One stage-3 mainstem fragment, all 22 original parts and 71 stored positions, the chosen opening, all intervening joins, glacial receiver turn, fjord-head transition and separate source/render/stored ending definitions have complete ordinary geographic coverage in the actually inspected original. The result is a completed null-name scope hold, with no missing necessary receiver or through-link.

scope_limits: The chosen opening is not established as a natural river source, and full geographic coverage does not establish one continuous natural river.
No representative river hydronym is supported by this map reading; this is not proof that every local watercourse is officially unnamed.
Small offsets at exposed-rock margins are within the generalized national-scale terrain interpretation; no exact present wet-thread, ice-front or bank fit is claimed.
Historical fjord-head correspondence does not establish present surface or subglacial hydraulics, an ordinary river mouth or a surveyed river length.

The fjord and land labels are bounded geographic context and are not assigned as river names. No formal registry verification, Korean label, scalar whole-feature name or product application is asserted.

bounded_name_observations.role: Directly labelled receiving marine setting at the selected northern ending. It is not a river candidate.

bounded_name_observations.name: Mylius-Erichsen Land
bounded_name_observations.role: Directly labelled land region beside the selected eastern opening and lower glacial corridor; geographic context only.

records.region: Western Valle del Cauca, Colombia; forested western-slope valley, alluvial lowland and southern Buenaventura coastal-estuary setting
records.naming_scope_hold_reason: All selected ordinary valley, alluvial-floor and estuarine-wetland connections are supported, but this bounded pass did not obtain directly applicable name evidence. This is a name-evidence limit, not an unresolved necessary geographic receiver/link.
records.geographic_disambiguation: No representative hydronym is established by the actually read sources. Nearby or discovery-only names are not applied to the selected corridor.
records.completion_scope: Completed bounded null-name pass. The complete newly acquired photographic original and four overlapping unmarked native-resolution headward, middle, lower and terminal crops were inspected. Private orientation aids cover all 27 parts, the stage seam and separate endings. Three intended independent name sources failed before any original body was read; their discovery snippets are excluded. No further source expansion is proposed.
records.supported_name_scope: No representative hydronym is established by the actually read sources. Nearby or discovery-only names are not applied to the selected corridor.

records.region: Northwestern Buenos Aires Province, Argentine Pampas: agricultural depressions and lagoon-channel country in the Vedia–Leandro N. Alem vicinity.
records.material_pending_reason: The western opening of original part 0, especially its first seven stored positions (position indices 0–6, zero-based inclusive), crosses cultivated ground between distinct roughly north–south shallow depressions before entering the larger lagoon/wetland complex. The overview and a closer original image show the separate depressions but do not establish the necessary eastward through-link as one connected ordinary drainage corridor. This is a substantive connection gap, not a demand for an exact contemporary wet thread, engineered-operation proof or precise banks.
records.completion_scope: The bounded pass inspected the single original stage-3 mainstem fragment, all eight parts and 54 stored positions against a normally completed overview and closer western original. Parts1–7 and source/render ending contexts have ordinary geographic support; part 0 contains a specific unresolved western through-link. The primary result remains material-pending, not a completed null-name scope hold. A nearby regional channel name is withheld. No application changes or automatic naming were made.

scope_limits: The western selected through-link within original part 0 remains unestablished.
The imagery does not provide a representative hydronym or individual lagoon names.
The actual ending has receiving-corridor support, but the inventory endorheic class is not independently corroborated.
No precise natural source, surveyed mouth, contemporary wet-thread position, present canal operation or formal registry conclusion is asserted.

bounded_name_observations.role: Regional drainage recipient named in an independently read administrative resolution concerning rural works near Vedia and Leandro N. Alem. Not spatially assigned to a selected part or accepted as the representative name.

bounded_name_observations.role: Settlements named in the resolution as project-area context, not hydronyms or labels for the selected feature.

reconstruction_rule: Start from the pinned r46 cumulative index and apply later append-only deltas in verified commit order, rejecting duplicate IDs. Keep base records, scope clauses, region qualifiers and assessment histories unchanged. Apply explicit status-list changes. Subtract all recorded IDs from the exact eligible initial inventory to recover unrecorded targets; pending IDs remain recorded but are not completed source reviews.
publication_boundary: Own factual name/scope findings, public official URLs, bounded geometry metadata and public continuity pins only. No original maps, crops, complete coordinates or private source/derivative/registration fingerprints. Official hosting does not establish source redistribution rights.

research_order.progress_rule: Follow the actual continental order: Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, then other, with all rivers before lakes. Preserve original queue IDs and ranks for continuity; apply documented geographic deferrals without counting them as name research, and place deferred objects into their corrected later phase by length-descending, stable-ID order. Prior candidate and scope-held assessments remain unresolved where stated.
